Handles 410 Gone response correctly

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

do {
    let engineObj = try createEngine(config: nil)
    let url = "https://example.com"
    _ = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
} catch {
    let _errorMessage = String(describing: error)
    let _errorType = String(describing: type(of: error))
    XCTAssertTrue(_errorMessage.contains("gone") || _errorType.contains("gone"), "expected error to mention \"gone\", got message: \(_errorMessage), type: \(_errorType)")
}
```
